why.fund: Posts the official documents: reports, orders, notices and forms.
why.us: Explains what they mean in plain language, and links back to every original.

why.fund: Organizes documents by type and date.
why.us: Connects them into one story: the timeline, the money, and what changed.

why.fund: Speaks for the Fund, to its members.
why.us: Speaks to everyone else too: families, students, journalists and policymakers.

why.fund: Covers the Settlement Fund’s own business.
why.us: Also follows the Legislature, the budget, health insurance, and pension news across the Pacific and the U.S.

why.fund: Stays neutral, as an official body must.
why.us: Hosts the conversation: stories, questions, podcasts and reader feedback.

principles.title: Every claim has a source
principles.body: Each fact links to the court order, law, report or notice it comes from.

principles.title: Plain words first
principles.body: We explain before we quote, and define every technical term.

principles.title: Facts, not sides
principles.body: We report what the documents say. We do not campaign for any official or party.

principles.title: Dated and updated
principles.body: Every page shows when it was last checked, and we correct mistakes openly.
